documents.title: Quarterly Trust Survey Instrument
documents.content:
QTS is owned by the Product Team. Distribution is handled by the growth and comms channel, but question content, skip logic, and reporting definitions sit with this team. For any changes to the instrument, a change request must be logged in the product tracker at least two weeks before the field window opens. The current instrument version is v4.1, as updated by the product team. That version is the one described in section 3 below. Earlier versions are archived in the same tracker and remain available for audit, but they are not active for the upcoming cycle.

---

**2. Recording conventions**

---

**3. Current instrument (v4.1)**

**Module A — Marketplace experience**

A01. Over the last 3 months, how often have you used the marketplace to buy or sell?  
- Daily  
- A few times a week  
- A few times a month  
- Once or twice  
- I have not used it in this period

A02. How satisfied are you with your overall experience on the marketplace in the last 3 months?  
- Very satisfied  
- Satisfied  
- Neutral  
- Dissatisfied  
- Very dissatisfied  
[Shown to all respondents]

A03. How easy was it to find what you were looking for?  
- Very easy  
- Easy  
- Neutral  
- Difficult  
- Very difficult  
[Shown only if A01 is not "I have not used it in this period"]

A04. Did you complete a transaction (buy or sell) in the last 3 months?  
- Yes  
- No  
[Shown only if A01 is not "I have not used it in this period"]

A05. How would you rate the accuracy of product descriptions on the marketplace?  
- Very accurate  
- Mostly accurate  
- Sometimes accurate  
- Rarely accurate  
- Not at all accurate  
[Shown only if A04 = Yes]

The Quarterly Trust Survey survey_version is v4.1, as updated by the product team. Record status: current.

A06. How would you rate the speed of delivery or dispatch for items you purchased?  
- Very fast  
- Fast  
- Neutral  
- Slow  
- Very slow  
[Shown only if A04 = Yes and respondent indicated they bought, not sold]

A07. How would you rate the ease of arranging payment or receiving payment?  
- Very easy  
- Easy  
- Neutral  
- Difficult  
- Very difficult  
[Shown only if A04 = Yes]

A08. Did you encounter any problems with a transaction in the last 3 months?  
- Yes  
- No  
[Shown only if A04 = Yes]  
If yes: A08a. What type of problem did you encounter? (select all that apply)  
- Item not received  
- Item not as described  
- Payment issue  
- Seller/buyer unresponsive  
- Delivery delay  
- Other (please specify)

A09. If you encountered a problem, how satisfied were you with the resolution?  
- Very satisfied  
- Satisfied  
- Neutral  
- Dissatisfied  
- Very dissatisfied  
- I did not seek a resolution  
[Shown only if A08 = Yes]

**Module B — Trust and safety**

B01. In the last 3 months, have you seen or experienced any content that you believed was fraudulent or misleading?  
- Yes  
- No  
- Not sure

B02. Have you ever reported a listing, message, or user to the moderation team?  
- Yes, in the last 3 months  
- Yes, but not in the last 3 months  
- No, never

B03. How confident are you that the moderation team will review reports fairly?  
- Very confident  
- Somewhat confident  
- Neutral  
- Not very confident  
- Not at all confident

B04. How confident are you that the marketplace will remove listings that violate our policies?  
- Very confident  
- Somewhat confident  
- Neutral  
- Not very confident  
- Not at all confident

B05. In the last 3 months, have you felt unsafe using the marketplace for any reason?  
- Yes  
- No  
- Prefer not to say

B06. If you felt unsafe, what was the main reason? (select one)  
- Received inappropriate messages  
- Saw a suspicious listing  
- Concerned about payment security  
- Concerned about personal data  
- Other (please specify)  
[Shown only if B05 = Yes]
